about: Avec Anima is an underground house and tech house night on the Isle of Man, running events at venues across the island — from Douglas clubs to one-off nights in the glens.
homeTagline: Underground house & tech house nights on the Isle of Man. No two are the same.
homeVideoText: Live sets on YouTube, curated playlists from our selectors on SoundCloud — a taste of what Avec Anima sounds like between shows.
homeSoundcloudText: Not recordings from our nights — these are playlists carefully curated by the Avec Anima selectors. Every track is hand-picked and sequenced by the people behind the decks: the underground house and tech house they're playing, digging for and can't stop coming back to. Press play and let it run.
galleryIntro: After movies and photos from Avec Anima nights across the Isle of Man. Hover over a film to preview it, or tap it to watch with sound.
musicIntro: Live sets, warehouse highlights, and a look behind the scenes from Avec Anima nights. New uploads on our YouTube channel after every show.
musicSoundcloudText: Playlists carefully curated by the Avec Anima selectors — not recordings from our nights, but hand-picked, properly sequenced selections of the underground house and tech house they're playing and digging for right now. Follow along to hear the sounds that shape our lineups before they land on the dancefloor.
storeComingSoonText: The Avec Anima store is on its way. Check back soon.
